name: site-memory
description: Read-only site-memory MCP server: query sites, flows, runs and step stats recorded by `xbrowser site-memory run`. Never dispatches input, never opens a browser.

interface.longDescription: Expose the sanitized xbrowser site-memory ledger as read-only MCP tools. Workflows run only when explicitly invoked via `xbrowser site-memory run <workflow.json>` in a throwaway headless browser; this plugin only queries the recorded history (sites, flows, runs, per-step stats and verified hints) and never dispatches browser input.
defaultPrompt: 列出 site-memory 里最近的 workflow 运行和各步骤的失败分布。
查一下这个站点哪个流程最近验证通过，常用选择器候选是什么。
